summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the new per-account 'deal room' (/workspace/account/:leadId). Backend: 27/27 pytest cases pass (was 21, added 6 for the account room). New coverage: GET /workspace/account/{lead_id} returns the expected shape {lead, linked_deal_id, hubspot:{connected,error,deals,contacts,deal_fields}, actions, timeline} with hubspot.connected=true + hubspot.error='HubSpot authentication failed...' (demo token, expected), timeline populated from the intent lead activity (>=1 item), 404 on unknown lead; POST /workspace/account/{lead}/link works (linked_deal_id persists on GET), 404 on unknown lead; POST /workspace/account/{lead}/fields returns 400 when unlinked, 400 when no changes, and graceful 422 'HubSpot authentication failed...' after link with demo token (expected); account_ref scoping: a 'deal' draft created with account_ref appears in that account's actions list AND in its timeline as source='inflow', and is absent from a second lead's account page. Frontend: On /discover the guided flow-dialog opens for a lead, flow-manage-footer + flow-manage-btn are present at the bottom, clicking Manage navigates to /workspace/account/lead_d0edd59db085. account-workspace-page renders with account-name 'Bluth Company', account-unlinked-badge, account-hub-error showing the demo-token reconnect message, 8 timeline items rendered (timeline-item-0..7), all 5 kind pills (note/task/call/email/deal), account-push-fields-btn is correctly disabled while unlinked. Full push flow verified: selected 'deal' kind, filled account-deal-name='TEST_UI_deal_53', clicked account-save-btn -> pending action appeared, clicked Review & push -> account-confirm-dialog opened with preview 'Deal: TEST_UI_deal_53', account-confirm-push -> HTTP 422 -> action status flipped to 'failed' with the readable HubSpot error inline; account-delete-{id} removes the action; account-back-btn navigates back to /discover. The demo-token 422s and empty deals dropdown are EXPECTED per the review request and NOT reported as bugs.

issues: Same '<span> cannot be a child of <select>' hydration warning observed on iter52 also fires here for account-link-select and the task priority native <select>. Cosmetic; does not break functionality. Likely visual-edits injection wrapping <option> in a <span>.

action_items: (Cosmetic, carried over from iter52) Silence the '<span> cannot be a child of <select>/<option>' React hydration warning. Now also present on the AccountWorkspace page for account-link-select and account-task-priority.
critical_code_review_comments: workspace.account_room() auto-links a HubSpot deal by case-insensitive account name match when there's no error and no explicit link. Good UX when a real token is present. With demo token tg.get('error') is truthy so auto-link is skipped — correct.
workspace.update_account_fields() sends only fields that are provided (dealname/amount/dealstage) — no accidental blanking of unspecified fields. Good.

AccountWorkspace.js delete has no confirm dialog; a single click on account-delete-{id} destroys a draft/failed action. Acceptable since executed actions can't be deleted from UI (button hidden), but a small confirm would prevent accidents. Low priority.

test_account_link_and_fields_422 sets lead.hubspot_deal_id='TEST_hs_deal_123' on the first lead; this persists in Mongo and will surface as linked_deal_id on subsequent test runs / manual QA of that lead. Not harmful because demo-token writes 422 anyway, but consider a teardown that unsets hubspot_deal_id, or expose an /unlink endpoint. (Testing agent did not add DB teardown — main agent may want to seed cleanup.)
seed_data_creation: test_account_link_and_fields_422 links the first intent lead to hubspot_deal_id='TEST_hs_deal_123' in Mongo — no code endpoint to unlink; if a next iteration expects an unlinked state, main agent should reset lead.hubspot_deal_id or add an /unlink endpoint. Test-created workspace_actions are cleaned via fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression covers 27 tests in /app/backend/tests/test_workspace.py incl. the new account-room endpoints. All expected demo-token failures (422 on execute/fields, empty deals list, hubspot.error string) are asserted as PASS conditions — do not flip them. A prior test link ('TEST_hs_deal_123') may still be on the first intent lead in Mongo; use a different lead index or add an unlink step if you require the unlinked state.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. The 422s and empty deals dropdown are the intentional graceful-fail path for testpro's demo HubSpot token. All new UI + API contracts (Manage button navigation, header/badges/timeline, kind pills, composer, save-draft, confirm dialog, review&push, delete, back, field-push validation, account_ref scoping) function as specified.
